title: New Scenery & Airports in MSFS2024 Marketplace ✈️🌍 | Weekly Update | Week 33
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Check out the latest updates in Microsoft Flight Simulator! This week, the addition of historical airports continues, and modern airports in Africa have also been included. As a bonus, new lighting enhancements are now available for Amsterdam, Cape Town, Copenhagen, Malmö, and Dublin. Dive into these fantastic updates and experience how they elevate your flight simulation adventures. Don’t miss out on these incredible improvements!

📹 Other marketplace additions
